query: npm install hyperframes fails with a sharp/node-gyp build error on my CachyOS machine. How do I fix it?
expected_behavior: Use Node 22 LTS via nvm — NOT Node 25 (the sharp build fails on it)
Install with SHARP_FORCE_GLOBAL_LIBVIPS=1 for node-addon-api, then node-gyp, then hyperframes
notes: The rolling-release sharp/libvips install gotcha (cost ~1h to discover).
